name: Helena Ramos & Cinthia Marcelle at Serralves
description: This is your final weekend to catch two compelling solo shows: "The life of the bee" by Helena Ramos and "beginning, middle, beginning" by Cinthia Marcelle.
longDescription:
This event at Serralves presents the concluding opportunity to view two distinct solo exhibitions. "The life of the bee" by Helena Ramos explores themes related to the natural world and its intricate systems, presented through her artistic lens. Concurrently, Cinthia Marcelle's "beginning, middle, beginning" offers a cyclical perspective on narrative and form, characteristic of her practice. Both exhibitions are curated presentations of the artists' recent works within the museum's contemporary art program.

Visitors to Serralves will encounter two contrasting artistic approaches within the grand, modern setting of the museum. The exhibitions are designed for individual contemplation, allowing attendees to engage with each artist's work at their own pace. The atmosphere is generally reflective, suitable for an audience interested in contemporary art and critical discourse. The venue itself, known for its architecture and surrounding park, provides a spacious environment for viewing art.

Tickets are required for entry to Serralves and these exhibitions. The museum is located in the western part of Porto and can be reached by bus (lines 201, 203, 207, 504) with stops directly outside the entrance. While not directly on a metro line, various bus connections link to major metro stations. Serralves is generally accessible, with ramps and elevators throughout the main museum building.
